@drboycewatkins1 There lies the challenge of the #metoo movement. African-Americans have fought, advocated for due process, the right to be heard, to confront your accuser, to the presumption of innocence- unsubstantiated, not corroborated accusations is a dangerous place for justice for us.

@drboycewatkins1 Women deserve to be protected, heard, listened to and believed. They deserve due process- the right to confront their accuser. How does the judicial system and/or political system protect due process for all in this #metoo era?

@drboycewatkins1 I had my own experience with issues surrounding the #metoo movement. As Black woman who is rearing two males, having practiced criminal law, our judicial system is woefully lacking in its protection of due process for young Black males. I remain an advocate for due process.
Moving!Touching! Needed! For all the little girls who hopefully will never have a #MeToo moment. Never silent again. We advocate for strength to speak up-speak loud.
